# On and off by default — the `tailwind` pack

Back to [what a fresh install turns on](../defaults.md) · [every rule of the pack](../README.md#tailwind).

- **Installed by `codelaw init` when:** `tailwindcss` in `package.json`, a `tailwind.config.*`, or a stylesheet that imports it.
- **Rules:** 8 — 0 on, 5 on with `preview = true`, 0 off in an opt-in preset, 3 in no preset.

## Presets

| Preset | Written by `init` | Rules | Severities | What it is |
|---|---|--:|---|---|
| `tailwind/recommended` | yes, once the pack is installed | 5 | 1 error, 4 warn | eslint-plugin-better-tailwindcss and eslint-plugin-tailwindcss's bug-catching rules, reimplemented (W-145) |

## Rules

`on` runs in a fresh install; a `preview` rule runs only with `preview = true` ([SR-RULE-PACKS](../../../records/0101_rule-packs.md) decision 9). † a preset `init` writes only when the repo has what it is for.

| Rule | By default | Severity | Preset |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`tailwind/enforces-canonical-classname`](../tailwind/enforces-canonical-classname.md) | off — in no preset | — | — |
| [`tailwind/enforces-negative-arbitrary-values`](../tailwind/enforces-negative-arbitrary-values.md) | on with `preview = true` | warn | `tailwind/recommended` |
| [`tailwind/important-modifier-suffix`](../tailwind/important-modifier-suffix.md) | on with `preview = true` | warn | `tailwind/recommended` |
| [`tailwind/no-arbitrary-value`](../tailwind/no-arbitrary-value.md) | off — in no preset | — | — |
| [`tailwind/no-concatenated-classes`](../tailwind/no-concatenated-classes.md) | on with `preview = true` | warn | `tailwind/recommended` |
| [`tailwind/no-conflicting-classes`](../tailwind/no-conflicting-classes.md) | on with `preview = true` | error | `tailwind/recommended` |
| [`tailwind/no-restricted-classes`](../tailwind/no-restricted-classes.md) | off — in no preset | — | — |
| [`tailwind/no-unknown-classes`](../tailwind/no-unknown-classes.md) | on with `preview = true` | warn | `tailwind/recommended` |
